one_liner: Xero is a broad REST accounting API with OAuth 2.0 and a free Starter tier capped at 5 connected orgs, plus a vendor-run MCP server.
auth_notes: Register an OAuth 2.0 app in the developer portal to get a client ID and secret. Custom Connections offer a client-credentials grant for bespoke integrations. The pages don't show any API-key auth. I removed the draft's claim that Custom Connections are a paid add-on because the pages don't support it.
access_notes: New apps start on the free Starter tier (no monthly fee), capped at 5 connected organizations and 1,000 calls per day per org. Core ($35 AUD per month) allows 50 connections and needs a payment method but no certification. Plus and above need App Certification. Advanced and above also need a security assessment. The Journals endpoint, XPM API and bulk connections need Advanced plus approval. The Remote MCP server is demo org only on Starter.
blocker_notes: A free self-serve start works, but a multi-user toolkit needs more than 5 orgs. That requires a paid tier, and certification from Plus upward. Journals and some reporting scopes need Advanced-tier approval. Xero's terms reportedly forbid using API data to train AI models (per Apideck).
